title: Define beam configurations and load cases
action: Implement the material property constants and beam geometries for the three test beams (a), (b) and (c) as given in the paper's Section 4. Define the two load cases: pressure load and actuation potential.
description: Preparatory step to encode beam layups, material properties, and load case parameters in code so they can be used by the solver.

title: Compute response using coupled layerwise theory
action: Implement the coupled layerwise theory (Section 2) and solve the governing equations analytically for simply-supported beams (Section 3) using Fourier series. For each beam (a, b, c), slenderness ratio (S=5,10,100), and load case (pressure or actuation potential), compute the non-dimensional central deflection, maximum stresses, electric potential/displacement, and for beam (c) the through-thickness electric potential profile at x=a/2. Non-dimensionalise quantities as defined in Section 4.
description: JSON file containing the computed non-dimensional deflection, stresses, electric potential/displacement for beams (a) and (b) at S=5,10,100, and the electric potential profile and central deflection for beam (c) at S=5.
output_schema: {"beam_a": {"load_case_1": {"S=5": {"w": float, "sigma_x_e": float, "sigma_x_p": float, "tau_zx": float, "phi": float}, "S=10": {...}, "S=100": {...}}, "load_case_2": {"S=5": {"w": float, "sigma_x_e": float, "sigma_x_p": float, "tau_zx": float, "D_z": float}, ...}}, "beam_b": {...}, "beam_c": {"load_case_1": {"S=5": {"w_center": float, "phi_profile": [{"z/h": float, "phi_nondim": float}, ...]}}, "load_case_2": {"S=5": {...}}}}
